text: I have so much to say about Bituach Leumi and not a single good thing... We went through a similar situation with our second child like 4 months ago (surprisingly, the first time there were no problems). We got a message that we can apply for 303 only in the month of the due date (and my due date was at the beginning of July...). It took my husband two full weeks of everyday calls to BL and yelling at them to finally find someone competent. We got the document in the last moment.
